tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Shows the Cruma account this connection is signed in as (account id, name, email), the organizations it belongs to, and the one this connection acts in.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: Lists the Cruma services available on this account, and whether each is answering. Use describe_service to learn what one does and which tools it has.

tools.name: describe_service
tools.description: Describes one service from list_services: what it does, and its tools with the scope each needs and whether it asks for confirmation. The service's tools are listed from then on.

service.description: The service's key, as list_services names it.

tools.name: select_organization
tools.description: Makes this connection act in one of the organizations whoami lists, instead of the personal one. The services and tools available can differ per organization.

organization.description: The organization's id, as whoami lists it.

tools.name: tunnels-list_tunnels
tools.description: Lists the tunnels of the organization the connection acts in, each with its public address, tier and whether it is connected now.

tools.name: tunnels-get_tunnel
tools.description: Shows one tunnel by its id: its address, custom hostname state, tier and whether it is connected now.

tools.name: tunnels-create_tunnel
tools.description: Creates a tunnel from a name, an optional description and an optional tier (free when omitted). Answers with the new tunnel and its address.

tools.name: subscriptions-get_subscription
tools.description: Shows the Cruma plan of the account the connection acts in: each subscription with its plan, status and renewal date (`renews_at`), the tunnel allocations it grants per tier, and the plans that can be started (`available_plans`).

tools.name: subscriptions-change_subscription
tools.description: Returns a link where the user starts or changes their Cruma plan in their own browser. Payment never goes through the agent: this tool takes no payment details, completes no purchase and changes nothing by itself.
